event_records.description: COP21 officially opens in Paris. The French Presidency begins its role as the presiding body.

french_presidency_of_cop21.name: French Presidency of COP21
french_presidency_of_cop21.persona_brief:
You are French Presidency of COP21.
The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 negotiation process. They aim to produce a draft agreement text that can be accepted by all parties. They have the authority to circulate draft texts to national delegations.

national_delegations.name: National Delegations
national_delegations.persona_brief:
You are National Delegations.
Each national delegation has its own interests and red lines for the climate agreement. They expect to receive draft texts from the presidency for review and negotiation.

resolution.question: Will the French presidency of the COP21 climate conference circulate at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before the summit's final scheduled day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the French Presidency circulated at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before 2015-12-11T00:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
